name: wmi-subscription-persistence-win
description: Practice-box helper (Windows): plants WMI event-subscription persistence -- a root\subscription __EventFilter (fires every 60s), a CommandLineEventConsumer running a hidden PowerShell payload, and the __FilterToConsumerBinding that couples them. No file, service, or Run key is involved, so the usual autoruns tools show nothing; the hardened state is the binding/filter/consumer triple gone. Vars: FILTER_NAME (required); CONSUMER_NAME (required); PAYLOAD_PATH (required); PAYLOAD_BODY (optional). Pairs with a powershell_json check counting __FilterToConsumerBinding instances under root\subscription (0 = hardened). Idempotent: existing named objects are removed before recreation.
